verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: The permission-aware query path is strongest: question rewriting, parallel vector and keyword lookup, fusion and reranking, user ACL filtering before generation, evidence-gated grounding, citations, and the feedback loop are all clearly connected.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: Failure handling is incomplete, especially the absent guarantee that parse failures do not stop the rest of the batch; quarantine context and dead-letter payload/reprocessing semantics are also only partial or absent.
verdict.coverage_summary: The board substantially covers the primary RAG architecture, version-consistent three-store publication, permission-aware grounded retrieval, feedback prioritization, and atomic index rebuilding. Important operational qualifiers remain weak: source types and boilerplate removal are absent, quarantine does not show failure context or batch continuation, dead-letter storage lacks inputs and attempt history, overlap and several per-fragment metadata guarantees are incomplete, and rollback does not explicitly retain the prior generation. Weighted coverage is 66.5 of 82, or approximately 0.811; the absent system-defining batch-continuation requirement applies the RC cap of 6.
